en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a small lookout tower standing on a hilltop, reached by a stone stairway and surrounded by dense trees and bushes. The tower has a tall, narrow base with an external wooden staircase leading to a railed viewing platform and a simple pyramidal structure above it. The reverse side contains handwritten Hungarian text in blue ink, a green 40 fillér Magyar Posta stamp, postmark, address lines, and printed publisher information.
